correctness.rationale: The finite irreducible embedded reset chain has unique pi; stationary renewal-age density is survival(t)/E tau, not the original Pareto density. Its Bessel-square integral equals an exact gamma ratio by Weber-Schafheitlin; the small-t correction decays faster than powers and the ratio has no first 1/k term since the gamma shifts sum to 1. Translating k=n-j and mixing over pi gives the +/-alpha b/n skew and K_alpha. Positive tails imply moment q iff alpha>q+1, while ballistic Bessel identity E[(X-j)^2|t]=gamma^2 t^2/2 gives the finite second moment via E tau^3/(3 E tau). At alpha=3, two tails yield gamma^2 tau0^2/3 log N. Independently integrated the Bessel Mellin integral at alpha=2.3, order 9, cutoff 800 with relative discrepancy 8.5e-6, accounted for by finite tail. This is not a finite-lattice variance assertion.
